snippet.title: Tekken 6  - Octave Engine Game Demonstration Beta TGS 2007
snippet.description:
This video showcases the use of the Octave Engine that was developed for Tekken 6.

Here you can see some glimpse of an Early Tekken 6 Arcade vers running on System 357 and learn a bit more about the technology behind this game's graphics and physics, which was quite impressive for its time.
